Nice Restaurant at The Park Hyatt
Feb 2026 • Couples
We stayed at the Park Hyatt for 7 nights and had breakfast at Opera every morning. We had some servers who understood English and others not so much. They have a nice a breakfast buffet, but we chose to order off the menu. Omelets were good as well as waffles. They have a nice coffee counter where they make anything you want. The place is very pretty. 

At lunch and dinner it becomes a completely different place. You can watch them making pasta and it has a more elegant air, waiter with white coats etc. Pasta was Ok not great. I really liked the Tiramasu made at the table. We had lunch and dinner here a few times. The pizza was really good, saladsand soup as well. Again, it was nice to have a place in the hotel to eat.

Such a let down!
Dec 2025 • Family
I am extremely disappointed with the level of service experienced at this restaurant. Despite specifically requesting that our meals be prepared and served as promptly as possible, we waited in excess of one hour. When the food did arrive, the four meals were delivered separately rather than together.

Adding to the frustration, other tables who arrived after us and ordered the same dish (lasagne) were served before us.

To make matters worse, a compulsory 5% service charge was automatically added to the bill. When this was queried, we were informed that it could not be removed. Given the standard of service received, this was both surprising and unacceptable.

Overall, the experience was a significant let-down and fell well below reasonable expectations.

Solid Brunch option
Aug 2025 • Friends
A very nice place for Sunday brunch, very high quality food all around and exceptional value for money free flow drinks package at VND 350k. A mix of buffet and a la carte options available, only thing I would say is that service is definitely more attentive to regulars, several orders were missed while they were swooning over a few tables that had clearly been before. The chef was present throughout but mainly interested at speaking to one table. All in all a solid option for brunch if you don’t mind a few service mishaps, on the plus side drinks were refilled very promptly

One of the best in Saigon
May 2024 • Couples
After enjoying The Opera restaurant at Park Hyatt Saigon for a decade, I think its very safe to say for a true 5 star fine dining with great ambiance, food and most of all, great service, in Saigon, this one is the best 2. Their Sunday brunch is among the best in the world (not in Vietnam). Their new Family set menu on Friday/ Saturday nights is very good and so plenty for such a great price. If I think of a very elegant dining time - this is the place. And to make it such a great experience, I warmly thank all the talented chefs especially the new one who prepared the Family set menu I’ve had just 2 days ago and : a long standing ovation for Ms. Celia who, over the years, constantly has taken great care of her guests. Nothing is a No for her. She always tries her best to make even impossible things happen to make guests so happy. You are the Gem at Park Hyatt, Celia. And you’ve trained amazing staffs we appreciate all the staffs’ highly professional service where Ms. Anh is the best of them. Thank you all and we will continue dining there for many years to come.
